audience.text: Go developers building applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel spreadsheets programmatically without external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Cell values are read and written through Cells.Get and Cells.Set using A1-style references, supporting string, float64, int, and bool types.
capabilities.title: Read and write cell data

capabilities.text: Font, fill, alignment, and border properties combine into a Style that can be applied to any cell via Cell.SetStyle.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styling

capabilities.text: Formulas are stored with Cell.SetFormula and evaluated by the built-in CalculateFormula engine, supporting SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN over ranges.
capabilities.title: Evaluate formulas

capabilities.text: DataValidation rules restrict cell ranges to dropdown lists or numeric ranges with custom error messages and styles.
capabilities.title: Add data validation

capabilities.text: Structured Table ranges with headers and auto-filters are added to worksheets using Worksheet.AddTable.
capabilities.title: Embed structured tables

capabilities.text: PNG or JPEG images are embedded into worksheets using Worksheet.AddPicture with anchor positioning.
capabilities.title: Embed pictures

capabilities.text: Workbook.ImportFromCSV and Workbook.ExportToCSV move data to and from CSV with a caller-supplied delimiter.
capabilities.title: Import and export CSV

capabilities.text: Workbook.SetPassword and Workbook.VerifyPassword add ECMA-376 Agile Encryption to protect saved workbooks.
capabilities.title: Encrypt workbooks with passwords

limitations.text: Cell references are A1-style strings only; tuple/array indices (e.g. [0, 0]) are not supported.
CalculateFormula supports only SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN; any other formula returns an error rather than being evaluated.
CSV import stores every field as a Go string and does not infer numeric or boolean types the way Cells().Set does when called directly with typed values.
Round-trip fidelity depends on preserving unmodified content verbatim from the original XML; only content touched since load is regenerated.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and editing of Excel workbooks using idiomatic Go code without requiring Microsoft Excel or external native libraries.
Supports low-memory processing of large Excel files via streaming row access, avoiding loading entire workbooks into memory.
Provides built-in formula evaluation for common aggregate functions (SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN) without external dependencies.
Allows password-based encryption of workbooks using ECMA-376 Agile Encryption (SHA-512 key derivation, AES-256-CBC).

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Go is a pure-Go library for creating, reading, and writing Excel workbooks in ECMA-376 Office Open XML .xlsx format with no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported Excel formula functions beyond SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN is not explicitly listed in the facts.
Whether streaming reader supports writing or only reading is not stated in the facts.
Whether the library supports older Excel formats (e.g., .xls) is not stated in the facts.

workflows.name: Create and save a new workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook using NewWorkbook, access its first worksheet, write cell values via Cells.Set, and save to disk using Workbook.Save.

workflows.name: Load, edit, and save an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing workbook using LoadWorkbook, access a worksheet and cell via Cells.Get, modify the cell value, and save the updated workbook.

workflows.name: Apply formatting to cells
workflows.text: Create a Style with Font, Fill, Alignment, and Border properties, then apply it to a cell using Cell.SetStyle.

workflows.name: Import data from CSV
workflows.text: Import data from a CSV file into a new workbook using Workbook.ImportFromCSV, specifying a delimiter, and save the result as an Excel file.

workflows.name: Process large files with streaming
workflows.text: Use StreamingReader.ProcessRows to iterate over rows in a large Excel file without loading the entire workbook into memory.

workflows.name: Add data validation rules
workflows.text: Create a DataValidation object specifying type, formula, and error settings, then attach it to a worksheet range using Worksheet.AddDataValidation.
